# Technicool Engineering (TCE) & V-Shift Elevators

> Technicool Engineering (TCE) is a premier mechanical climate engineering and vertical transportation contractor based in Multan, Pakistan. Founded in 2010, TCE specializes in commercial HVAC-R installations, Daikin VRV multi-zone systems, industrial chillers, and V-Shift passenger and cargo elevators.

## Company Overview
- **Name**: Technicool Engineering (TCE)
- **Tagline**: Make Your Desire Climate
- **Founded**: 2010 (Multan, Punjab, Pakistan)
- **Experience**: 15+ Years Track Record with 37+ Completed Landmark Projects
- **Headquarters**: Office No. 22, Inside Aneesa Center, Opp. MashAllah Electronics, Khanewal Road, Multan, Punjab 60000, Pakistan
- **Contact**: Phone: 061-6303281 | Mobile: 0300-4384978 | Email: info@technicool.com.pk
- **Website**: https://technicoolengineering.com/

## Core Engineering Divisions

### 1. Commercial HVAC-R Climate Solutions
- **Daikin VRV / VRF Multi-Zone Systems**: Variable Refrigerant Volume inverter systems for commercial towers, hotels, and hospitals.
- **Commercial Cassettes & Ducted Air Conditioning**: 4-way airflow ceiling cassettes and ducted concealed indoor units.
- **Residential Inverter Splits**: High-ambient 52°C T3 tropicalized split units.
- **Rooftop Packaged Units & Chillers**: High-tonnage central chiller plants and packaged air handlers.
- **Piping & Duct Fabrication**: In-house nitrogen-purged copper piping brazing and galvanized sheet metal ducting.

### 2. V-Shift Elevators & Vertical Transportation
- **Passenger Elevators**: Machine-Room-Less (MRL) and gearless traction passenger elevators.
- **Panoramic Observation Glass Lifts**: 180° semi-circular and full round sightseeing glass cars.
- **Hospital Bed & Stretcher Lifts**: Medical emergency stretcher cabins with antimicrobial wall finishes.
- **Villa & Home Platform Lifts**: Compact zero-pit platform lifts for private residences.
- **Landing Door Architecture**: Etched titanium, mirror hairline, and rose gold landing entrance doors.

## Factory Authorized Partnerships
- **Daikin**: Authorized Solutions Provider (VRV / VRF, Inverter Rooftops & Magnetic Chillers)
- **Midea**: Direct Dealership Partner (Commercial & Inverter Split Systems)
- **Acson International**: Authorized Equipment Partner (Commercial HVAC-R)
- **Cross Air**: Specialized Commercial Partner (Industrial Air Conditioning & Air Handling)
- **AirX Air Conditioners**: Authorized Channel Partner (Precision Engineered Cooling)

## Key Project Deployments
- Zaver Pearl Continental (PC) Hotel Gwadar (HVAC)
